how_to_apply: This is an offline recruitment. Eligible candidates must send their application by registered post or speed post - online/email/in-person submissions are not mentioned in the notification.
Download the prescribed application format from www.surguja.gov.in.
Fill in the application clearly, without errors, mentioning the post name, programme name, and category (Unreserved/OBC/SC/ST) at the top.
Self-attest photocopies of all required documents (see Documents Required section) and staple/tie the application with all documents as a single set.
Send the completed application only via registered post/speed post to: Office of the Chief Medical & Health Officer, Ambikapur, District Surguja (Chhattisgarh).
Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 08 September 2026, 5:00 PM - the department is not responsible for postal delay or non-receipt, and late applications will not be considered.
important_instructions: Only candidates who are original residents of Chhattisgarh are eligible; a residence certificate is mandatory at the time of document verification. Incomplete, unclear, or erroneous applications will be rejected; attaching unnecessary documents can also invalidate the application. No certificate or document will be accepted after the application deadline under any circumstance. All posts are purely contractual for one financial year at a time, governed by the NHM Chhattisgarh Contractual Human Resources Policy 2018 (as amended); the contract is automatically terminated on regular recruitment to the post. Selected candidates must make their place of posting their headquarters and reside there; the posting location is non-transferable, and requests for transfer will be treated as indiscipline. Selected candidates must submit an affidavit on ₹50 stamp paper in the prescribed format after selection. Candidates currently employed in government/semi-government institutions must submit a No Objection Certificate from their employer. Candidates previously dismissed from government service, or terminated from NHM or any government department for indiscipline, financial irregularity, or misconduct, are not eligible for any post. Selection does not automatically confer a right to appointment; final appointment depends on actual vacancy availability and other criteria. The recruitment process is subject to the final order of the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in SLP(C) No. 19668/2022; appointments are made subject to the outcome of that petition. Any legal dispute arising from this recruitment falls under the jurisdiction of the Surguja (Ambikapur) courts only, and the final decision on any dispute rests with the appointing authority/Chairperson of the District Selection Committee, Surguja. All updates related to this recruitment will be published only on www.surguja.gov.in and the office notice board - no other medium will be used for communication.

content_sections.heading: NHM Surguja Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted and selected as follows: Educational Qualification – 65% weightage: based on the average percentage of marks obtained across all years of the Graduation/Post-Graduation qualification (grade-to-percentage conversion applies where relevant, per the grading scheme followed by the candidate's institution) Skill Test / Written Test – 20 marks: conducted post-wise (written or computer-based, as applicable); candidates must score a minimum of 30% to remain eligible Experience – 10 or 15 marks: only experience relevant to the applied post is counted. Candidates currently/previously working under NHM Chhattisgarh get 3 marks/year (maximum 15); other candidates get 2 marks/year (maximum 10). Experience is counted only for government, semi-government, or government-aided institutions, and only for work performed after completing the prescribed qualification COVID-19 Bonus Marks: 10 bonus marks for candidates who served as temporary health workers in Chhattisgarh government health institutions for at least 6 months during the pandemic (Class 3/4 posts), per the Under Secretary, CG Health & Family Welfare Department order dated 03.02.2023; a candidate cannot claim both experience marks and bonus marks Final Merit List (posts with skill test): Educational Qualification marks + Experience/Bonus marks + Skill Test marks (out of 100) Screening-to-interview ratio: for 1–10 advertised posts, 10x candidates called; for 11–50 posts, 5x; for 50+ posts, 3x In case of equal marks, the candidate with the earlier date of birth (i.e. older in age) is given seniority A waiting list is prepared - 200% of sanctioned posts for up to 25 posts, 150% for 26–50 posts, and 100% for 50+ posts - valid for a minimum of one year or until the next fresh recruitment notification

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHM Surguja Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: This is an offline recruitment. Eligible candidates must send their application by registered post or speed post - online/email/in-person submissions are not mentioned in the notification. Download the prescribed application format from www.surguja.gov.in. Fill in the application clearly, without errors, mentioning the post name, programme name, and category (Unreserved/OBC/SC/ST) at the top. Self-attest photocopies of all required documents (see Documents Required section) and staple/tie the application with all documents as a single set. Send the completed application only via registered post/speed post to: Office of the Chief Medical & Health Officer, Ambikapur, District Surguja (Chhattisgarh). Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 08 September 2026, 5:00 PM - the department is not responsible for postal delay or non-receipt, and late applications will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: NHM Surguja Documents Required
content_sections.text: 10th mark sheet (as proof of date of birth) 12th mark sheet Graduation/Post-Graduation mark sheets (all years) Mandatory technical qualification degree/diploma certificates (all years) Relevant CG Council live registration certificate (subject-wise, where applicable) Caste certificate issued by a competent authority (if applicable), plus an income certificate issued within the last 3 years (for OBC candidates) PVTG category certificate, if applicable Domicile/residence certificate of Chhattisgarh, issued by a competent authority Live registration certificate from the District Employment Office Disability certificate (UDID), issued by a competent authority, if applicable Self ID proof, passport-size photograph, and address proof Experience/No Objection Certificate - valid only if issued by a government, semi-government, or government-aided institution

No certificate or document will be accepted after the application deadline under any circumstance. All posts are purely contractual for one financial year at a time, governed by the NHM Chhattisgarh Contractual Human Resources Policy 2018 (as amended); the contract is automatically terminated on regular recruitment to the post. Selected candidates must make their place of posting their headquarters and reside there; the posting location is non-transferable, and requests for transfer will be treated as indiscipline. Selected candidates must submit an affidavit on ₹50 stamp paper in the prescribed format after selection. Candidates currently employed in government/semi-government institutions must submit a No Objection Certificate from their employer. Candidates previously dismissed from government service, or terminated from NHM or any government department for indiscipline, financial irregularity, or misconduct, are not eligible for any post. Selection does not automatically confer a right to appointment; final appointment depends on actual vacancy availability and other criteria. The recruitment process is subject to the final order of the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in SLP(C) No. 19668/2022; appointments are made subject to the outcome of that petition. Any legal dispute arising from this recruitment falls under the jurisdiction of the Surguja (Ambikapur) courts only, and the final decision on any dispute rests with the appointing authority/Chairperson of the District Selection Committee, Surguja. faq.question: Q1. What is NHM Surguja Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a contractual recruitment drive by the Office of the CMHO, Ambikapur, District Surguja, under the National Health Mission Chhattisgarh, to fill 60 posts across 19 designations such as Dental Surgeon, MO-AYUSH, Staff Nurse, Community Health Officer, ANM, and others.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NHM Surguja Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 60 posts are to be filled across 19 post categories.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NHM Surguja Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 08 September 2026, up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for NHM Surguja Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post - ranging from 10th pass (Class 4) to postgraduate/professional medical degrees (Dental Surgeon, MO-AYUSH). See the Eligibility section for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NHM Surguja Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As on 01 January 2026, the minimum age is 18 years; the maximum is 64 years for managerial posts and 70 years for medical posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for NHM Surguja Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for NHM Surguja Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent offline, in the prescribed format, by registered post or speed post to the CMHO Ambikapur office, along with self-attested copies of all required documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for NHM Surguja Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on educational qualification marks (65% weightage), experience/bonus marks, and a skill test/written test (20 marks) where applicable, for a total of 100 marks.
